m: गुदाङ्कुर m. piles, Bhpr. vii, 17, 15.
गुदानिल m. breaking wind, L.

m: गुदौष्ठ n. the aperture of the anus, ii, 2, 3 f.

s: Na Kelane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-AtmaMakaM-sew .) Na, godate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

v: Kele BvA॰ Atma॰ aka॰ sew । godate agodizwa । jugude । gudam ।

na॰ guda--ka । malatyAgadvAre apAnavAyuniHsAraRadvAre “tatra sTUlAntrapratibadDamardDapaYcANgulaM gudamAhustasmin balayastisro'DyardDANgulAntaraBUtAH pravAhaRI 1 visarjjanI 2 saMvaraRI ceti । “caturaNgulAyatAH sarvAstiryyagekANgulocCritAH । SaNKAvarttaniBAScApi uparyyupari saMsTitAH । gajatAluniBAScApi varRataH samprakIrttitAH । romAnteByo yavADyardDo gudOzWaH parikIrttitaH” suSru॰ । tasya svarUpAdikamuktam । asya prARAyatanatA yAjYa॰ uktA yaTA “nABirojo gudaM SukraM SoRitaM SaNKakO taTA । mUrdDAM sakaRWahfdayaM prARasyAyatanAni ca” । asya upasarjjanatve kroqAdO Suketyatra guda iti pAWAntaraM tena striyAM NIz । BrazwagudA ityeva । 2 nAqIBede strI bahvAdi॰ vA NIzwApO । “AntreByaste gudAByaH” f॰ 10 । 163 । 3 । “gudAByaH yABirnAqIBirannarasaH samAnavAyunA DAtuzu nIyate tAByo nAqIByaH” BA॰ । 3 balayAkAre gudasTAne pu॰ । “udaraM ca gudO kozWyO vistAro'yamaTo SfRu” yAjYa॰ “bAhyAdgudabalayAt antare gudavalaye dve, tO ca gudO kOzWye kozWO nABeraDodeSe BavO” mitA॰ । vastutaH gudamastyatra arSa॰ ac । gudADArasTAnaparatAyAmeva triliNgatvam । ataeva “gudAH pAtrARi BfdukAmaDenuH” yaju॰ 18 । 86 । vyAKyAyAm vedadI॰ । “gudAH gudasTAnAni” ityuktam “sTUlagudayA sarpAn gudABiH” yaju॰ 25 । 7 mantravyAKyAyAM ca tena gudaparatve strItvaM CAndasamityuktaYca saNgacCate “sinDavo gudAH” Sata॰ brA॰ 6 । 4 । tataH aSmA॰ astyarTe ra । gudara tadyukte tri॰ ।
m: गुद m. an intestine, entrail, rectum, anus, VS.; TS. vi; ŚBr. iii, viii; Kauś. &c.
गुद f(आ, ई). (ifc. आ, g. क्रोदादि [or ई, g. बह्व्-आदि, not in Kāś. and in g. शोणादि])
गुद n. id.
गुद m. du. with कौष्ठ्यौ, the two intestines, Yājñ. iii, 95
a: गुदं — The anus; Y. 3. 93; Ms. 5. 136.; 8. 282. --Comp. --अंकुरः piles. --आवर्तः obstruction of the bowels. --उद्धवः piles. --ओष्ठः the opening of the anus. --कीलः, --कीलकः piles. --ग्रहः constipation, flatulence. --पाकः inflammation of the anus. --भ्रंशः prolapsus ani. --वर्त्मन् n. the anus. --स्तंभः constipation.

k.v: सक्थि क्लीबे पुमानूरुस्तत्सन्धिः पुंसि वङ्क्षणः। गुदं त्वपानं पायुर्ना वस्तिर्नाभेरधो द्वयोः॥

s: puM, (gudasya BraMSo'smAt । gudaM BagaM BraSyate'smAditi vA .) maladvAranirgamarogaH । tasya lakzaRam । “pravAhanAtisArAByAM nirgacCati gudaM vahiH । rUkzadurbbaladehasya gudaBraMSaM tamAdiSet ॥” iti mADavakaraH ॥ taccikitsA yaTA, -- “gudaBraMSe gudaM svinnaM snehenAktaM praveSayet । pravizwaM roDayedyatnAdgavyasacCidracarmmaRA ॥ padminyAH komalaM patraM yaH KAdecCarkarAnvitam । etanniScitya nirddizwaM na tasya gudanirgamaH ॥ mUzakARAM vasABirvvA gudaBraMSe pralepanam । susvinnamUzikAmAMsenATavA svedayedgudam ॥ vfkzAmlAnalacANgerIvilvapAWAyavAgrajam । takreRa SIlayet pAyuM BraMSArtto'naladIpanam ॥ mUzakAn daSamUlAni gfhRIyAduBayaM samam । tayoH kvATena kalkena pacettElaM yaToditam ॥ aByaNgAttasya tElasya gudaBraMSo vinaSyati । vinaSyati taTA tena gudamUlaM BagandaraH ॥” iti mUzakatElam । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (yadA guhyaM nirasyeta tadA kuryyAt kriyAmimAm । sahacaryyAbalAnAYca raso grAhyo GftaM payaH ॥ paktrA Gftena lepaH syAt tasya cedaM praSasyate । araRIpallavakvATo vApyaM lozwraM sacandanam ॥ prottapya vahnisadfSaM sahasA narasya nirvvApya kAYjikamaTo vidaDIta tadvat । sOKyaYca sAmyagudasecanakaM praSastaM saMveSyamaDyagudato dfQabanDanaM syAt ॥” iti gudaBraMSaH ॥ iti hArIte cikitsitasTAne tftoye'DyAye ॥ * ॥ aTAsya cikitsA । “gudaniHsaraRe SUle pAnamamlasya sarpizaH । praSasyate nirAmARA maTavApyanuvAsanam ॥ cANgerI koladaDyamlanAgarakzArasaMyutam । GftamutkvaTitaM peyaM gudaBraMSarujApaham ॥” iti cANgerIGftam ॥ * ॥ “sattavyapippalImUlaM savyozaviqadAqimam । peyamamlaM GftaM yuktyA saDAnyAjAjicitrakam ॥ daSamUlopasidDaM vA savilvamanuvAsanam । SatAhvA SawI vilvErvvA vacayA citrakeRa vA ॥ stabDaBrazwagude pUrvvaM snehasvedO prayojayet ॥” iti carake cikitsAsTAne daSame'DyAye ॥)
v: pu॰ “pravAhaRAtisArAByAM nirgacCati gudaM bahiH । rUkzadurbaladehasya gudaBraMSaM tamAdiSet” SudaBraMSamimaM kfcCraMpAnAByaNgAt prasADayet” suSrutokte rogaBede ।
m: गुद—भ्रंश m. = -निर्गम, Car. vi, 10; Suśr.

s: puM, (gudasya graha iva gudamASritya grahavat pravarttate ityarTaH । yadvA gudaM maladvAramaDikftya AByantarikasTAnaM gfhRAti DArayatIti graha + ac .) udAvarttarogaH । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 133 ॥
v: pu॰ gudaM tadvyApAraM gfhRAti graha--ac 6 ta॰ । udAvarttaroge hema॰ । udAvarttaSabde 1163 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: गुद—ग्रह m. spasm of the rectum, Car. v, 10, 13.

s: puM, (gudasya apAnasya maladbArasyetyarTaH yadvA gude kIla iva .) arSorogaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (yaTA, suSrute sUtrasTAne 46 aDyAye । “AnAhamedo gudakIlahikkASvAsApahaH SoRitapittakfcca ॥”)
v: pu॰ gude kIla iva । arSoroge rAjani॰ । arSaHSabde vivftiH । “sTUlakandastu nAtyuzRaH SUraRo gudakIlahA” suSru॰ “AnAhamedogudakIlahikkASvAsApaho vanyakulatTa ezaH” suSru॰ । svArTe ka । tatrArTe halA॰ ।
m: गुद—कील m. piles, Suśr. i, 46, 1, 34 and 6, 10.

s: puM, (gudakIla + svArTe kan .) gudakIlaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥
